web.title: Annual leave and sick leave during workers compensation [K600454]
web.description:
# Annual leave and sick leave during workers compensation
Whether an employee is entitled to accrue or take leave during a period of workers compensation will depend on the workers compensation law that applies to them.

## Does annual leave accrue during workers compensation?
### NSW, Qld, Tas, Vic and WA
In New South Wales, Queensland, Tasmania, Victoria and Western Australia annual leave will accrue during workers compensation if the employee would have otherwise been entitled to the accrual had they not been on workers compensation.

### South Australia
Usually, annual leave accrues during worker's compensation in South Australia.

The rules on annual leave accrual can be different for employees if they're totally incapacitated on workers compensation for 52 weeks or more.

Annual leave for these employees is treated as having been taken and paid for by the workers compensation payments.

However, employees that get annual leave loading under an award or agreement, still get paid the loading for the period of annual leave that is treated as having been taken and already paid.

### ACT
#### From 9 June 2023
This means that from 9 June 2023, annual leave will accrue during workers compensation if the employee would have otherwise been entitled to the accrual had they not been on workers compensation.

### Commonwealth employees
Annual leave will accrue for 45 weeks only, if the employee would have otherwise been entitled to the accrual had they not been on workers compensation.

## Can annual leave be taken during workers compensation?
### Annual leave taken during workers compensation in South Australia
This is because their accrued annual leave is treated as having been taken and paid for by the workers compensation payments.

## Employees returning to work
#### Example: Returning to work on reduced hours
In NSW, annual leave accrues during workers compensation. This means that Adam will accrue annual leave on both his hours worked and hours on workers compensation when he returns to work.

# Paid annual leave and sick and carer's leave - Frequently Asked Questions
- accumulating leave while on leave at half pay

## How does leave accumulate while on leave at half pay?
Annual leave and sick and carer’s leave will continue to accumulate based on the number of hours they would usually work.

The employee isn’t taking unpaid leave, they still accrue leave according to their ordinary weekly hours of work.
